title: loopzero-cloud chart values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on required LoopZero control-plane values. Schema catches B50-class bugs (port mismatch, missing wiring CM, missing DB Secret ref) at helmfile lint/template time instead of post-install readiness probe.

replicaCount.description: Number of loopzero-cloud replicas (>= 1 required for service routing)

repository.description: Container image repository (no defaulting allowed — must be explicit per env)

tag.description: Image tag — 'latest' acceptable for dev/standalone, MUST be SHA-pinned in drill/prod (validated via supply-chain admission policy)

wiringConfigMap.description: Name of the ConfigMap that wires loopzero-cloud to the rest of the platform (B33/B35 pattern). Empty value = broken wiring → instant startup crash.

dbCredentialsSecret.description: Name of the Secret holding DATABASE_URL (B33/B35 — same pattern as loopzero-api).

port.description: Service port MUST match the loopzero-cloud binary listen port (13002 per B50). Mismatch causes readiness probe connection refused for the entire deploy lifetime.

certIssuer.description: Cert issuer identifier. 'CFManaged' = Cloudflare-managed TLS at edge (drill/prod). For local k3d, use letsencrypt-staging or loopzero-local-ca-issuer.

domain.description: Base domain for loopzero-cloud routes (e.g., cloud.loopzero.example). Used by Ingress + Service URL templating.

resources.description: CPU/memory requests + limits. Required per platform-engineer Q3 D8 guardrails.

env.description: Extra environment variables. May be null/empty in dev; required values are templated by helmfile from Pulumi outputs in drill/prod.

imagePullSecrets.description: At least one pull secret required to pull from registry.digitalocean.com/loopzero-system (private DOCR).
